FinOps hub resources reachable this way
PaaS services — not members of any VNet
Still deployed in private mode — unchanged from the previous diagram
Azure Private Link connects your private endpoints directly to hub Storage and Azure Data Explorer across network, subscription, or tenant boundaries. This model needs no VNet peering.
The Toolkit's hub virtual network still exists for Toolkit-internal connectivity — this model doesn't remove it, and doesn't require it to reach Storage or Azure Data Explorer.
